current_issue: too many unlabeled dots or unreadable label carpets
proposed_rule: always label key nodes; smart truncation for others; full label on tap/click
rationale: Nodes must give at least a partial sense of what they are, especially in explode mode.

current_issue: loss of readability when chapter and column distinctions collapse
proposed_rule: chapter = main hue family; column = modulation/variant within chapter hue
rationale: Need to preserve thesis anchoring and view family simultaneously.

current_issue: filter UI risks eating screen space on mobile
proposed_rule: collapsed Focus button + compact drawer/bottom sheet + chip summary
rationale: Graph must remain central on mobile.

current_issue: circular cluster becomes unreadable in dense selections
proposed_rule: switch from simple radial explode to structured local clustered/pseudogrid layout at density threshold
rationale: Need readable, contained constellations instead of circular blobs.

current_issue: long CVE lists flood the focus
proposed_rule: aggregate into light clusters such as 'CVE techniques (n)' and 'Phases de crise (n)' with optional second-level explode
rationale: Preserves mobile readability and analytic clarity.

current_issue: secondary relational neighbors invade focused selection
proposed_rule: strict selection by view/band/column/row first; only faint secondary context allowed
rationale: Primary textual anchoring must override relational propagation.

current_issue: new matrices can become too rigid or too compressed
proposed_rule: use columns: Chap. | Struct. | Objets | Gouvern. | Crises | Acteurs | Concepts | Réf./Sources
rationale: This is the clearest hybrid of narrative structure and ontological precision.

current_issue: equalized widths make the view look blocky and unbalanced
proposed_rule: Chap.=0.6x; Struct.=0.8x; Objets=1.0x; Gouvern.=0.95x; Crises=0.9x; Acteurs=1.15x; Concepts=1.15x; Réf./Sources=1.2x
rationale: Visual weights should reflect information load and keep the old breathing quality.

current_issue: some chapter bands become brick-like while others remain thin
proposed_rule: cap visible node density per cell; push surplus to faint background or secondary cloud
rationale: Avoid solid walls of nodes.

current_issue: actor families read as a flat block
proposed_rule: order internally: StakeholderCategory -> Institution/Organization -> StakeholderGroup -> Person
rationale: Makes actor ontology readable at a glance.

current_issue: core concepts drown in technical concepts
proposed_rule: order internally: CoreConcept -> SecondaryConcept/TheoreticFramework -> TechnicalConcept -> NativeFormula
rationale: Restores analytic hierarchy.

current_issue: references and quotes form a murky terminal wall
proposed_rule: order internally: AcademicWork/Corpus -> PrimarySource -> Reference -> SourceQuote -> theoretical authors
rationale: Keeps the terminal reference zone legible.

current_issue: crisis nodes become too dense and bleed into neighboring columns
proposed_rule: airier spacing and lower default opacity for secondary crisis details
rationale: Crises should remain readable and distinct from Gouvern.

current_issue: transversal concepts get swallowed by Intro or duplicate visually everywhere
proposed_rule: keep Multi. as soft band for transversal items; main position still driven by primaryChapter
rationale: Prevents intro overload and preserves reuse without reanchoring.

current_issue: too few columns made the process hard to read
proposed_rule: use columns: Noyau | Émission | Circulation | Accès | Usages | Valorisation | Stabilisation
rationale: Best processual reading of monetization.

current_issue: unclear stratification of entities in process view
proposed_rule: use rows: Thèse | Dispositifs | Arènes | Acteurs | Cas | Réf.
rationale: Combines analytic and empirical levels cleanly.

current_issue: overly abstract labels reduce first-glance understanding
proposed_rule: keep short process labels and avoid hidden/rotated tiny text
rationale: Mobile-first readability.

current_issue: acting persons can disappear into references
proposed_rule: keep acting persons in Acteurs row; only theoretical authors go to Réf.
rationale: Needed for governance/maintenance reading within monetization.

current_issue: stabilization mixes governance, crises, proposals and maintenance into a blob
proposed_rule: subcluster internally by governance processes / crises / responses / persons / sources
rationale: Most dense and analytically important process column.

current_issue: process sequence not instantly legible
proposed_rule: Noyau=gold; Émission=amber; Circulation=cyan; Accès=turquoise; Usages=green; Valorisation=violet; Stabilisation=coral
rationale: Helps eye read process left-to-right while preserving overall style.

current_issue: previous versions lacked Struct. and/or Gouvern.
proposed_rule: use columns: Struct. | Gouvern. | Catégories | Organisations | Groupes | Arènes | Personnes | Cas / Réf.
rationale: Best match to thesis and governance question.

current_issue: need to distinguish routine, decision, conflict and maintenance
proposed_rule: use rows: Problématisation | Coordination | Décision | Conflit | Maintenance | Sources
rationale: Tracks governance modes rather than just actor piles.

current_issue: crisis detail invades governance reading
proposed_rule: keep governance concepts/processes in Gouvern.; crises remain in Cas / Réf. or dedicated crisis focus
rationale: Prevents CVE/DAO overload in governance focus.

current_issue: acting persons disappear among actor clouds
proposed_rule: prioritize labels for acting persons when row is Décision, Conflit or Maintenance
rationale: Users need to see who actually governs.

current_issue: arena column is original but visually under-expressed
proposed_rule: slightly brighter halo and clearer labels for arenas
rationale: Arenas are key to this thesis’ governance approach.

current_issue: cases and references collapse together
proposed_rule: internal vertical split: upper area for cases/crises, lower area for references/sources
rationale: Restores terminal clarity without adding another column.

current_issue: active filter state can be unclear
proposed_rule: always show compact summary chips like 'Chap. III · Gouvern. · Éclater' with close button
rationale: Users must know what they are seeing.

current_issue: same explode strategy used for sparse and dense selections
proposed_rule: use simple local radial explode below threshold; switch to clustered explode above threshold
rationale: Adaptive strategy fits both sparse and dense cases.

current_issue: selected nodes still unreadable in explode mode
proposed_rule: raise label density only for selected set; keep background labels dim or hidden
rationale: Avoid text carpet while making focus useful.

current_issue: explode clusters invade neighboring columns and bands
proposed_rule: keep explode selection inside local bounded ellipse/box per selected cell or area
rationale: Readable but contained expansion.

current_issue: secondary context competes visually with focus selection
proposed_rule: limit secondary context to opacity 0.12–0.20 with no labels by default
rationale: Context must remain context.

current_issue: everything enlarged equally reduces differentiation
proposed_rule: enlarge only key nodes and selected labels modestly; keep others near base size
rationale: Hierarchy should remain visible.

current_issue: long drifting animations reduce control
proposed_rule: short, stable transitions; no prolonged floating after focus apply
rationale: Graph should feel controlled, not decorative.

current_issue: generic subtext under-expresses thesis
proposed_rule: make visible: analytic question + entity families + reading promise
rationale: Entry cards should teach the map before opening it.

current_issue: concept card reads like generic theory menu
proposed_rule: frame as architecture of analysis, not list of concepts
rationale: Concepts structure the inquiry.

current_issue: crisis card can sound event-based only
proposed_rule: frame crises as governance-revealing episodes
rationale: This is a central thesis claim.

current_issue: protocol card risks sounding purely technical
proposed_rule: stress mediations, intermediaries and socio-technical extensions
rationale: Protocols are studied as worlds, not just code.

current_issue: cells now read as heavy bricks rather than breathing clouds
proposed_rule: center irregular porous clouds inside each cell with internal margins
rationale: Restore the older, more organic visual breathing while keeping new structure.

current_issue: all entities are shown at same intensity, causing overloaded blocks
proposed_rule: apply visual budget per cell: key nodes foreground, secondary nodes background, optional aggregation
rationale: Information should not all compete equally.

current_issue: reference columns become terminal walls
proposed_rule: keep reference areas porous with lighter halos and stricter label selection
rationale: References need terminal separation without becoming visual sludge.

current_issue: crisis areas become too compact and alarming
proposed_rule: extra spacing + cluster logic + fewer simultaneous labels
rationale: Crises should stay legible and analytically segmented.

current_issue: core concepts and technical concepts weigh the same visually
proposed_rule: give core concepts slightly larger nodes and more persistent labels
rationale: Analytic hierarchy must be visible.
